content:
Meta's streak at the top of the U.S. and Canadian App Store charts continues, with its AI assistant Muse surpassing 5 million downloads according to Sensor Tower data. Details below.

Muse has held the No. 1 spot on the U.S. App Store's free app chart for 12 consecutive days

Three weeks ago, Meta launched Muse in the United States. It quickly dethroned ChatGPT to become the top free app on the U.S. App Store.

Sensor Tower senior insights analyst Kara Lee projects that Muse has now surpassed 5 million downloads today. That means Muse reached this milestone far faster than ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude — which took 56 days, 103 days, and 492 days respectively to hit the same mark, according to Sensor Tower.

Muse is Meta's agentic AI assistant that can browse the web and carry out tasks on a user's behalf, including sending emails, shopping, filling out forms, and booking trips.

Sensor Tower adds that Claude and Grok were initially available only on iOS for their first five days. By contrast, Meta's Muse app supports both iOS and Android, though it is currently limited to users in the U.S. and Canada.

Here's more context from Sensor Tower comparing how quickly Muse reached 5 million downloads compared to other major apps:

The report also notes that while Meta's Muse app has clearly captured public attention, Meta's own ad push likely contributed to its rapid adoption.

Meta began ramping up advertising for Muse on Wednesday, September 16, 2026, driving a 73% day-over-day surge in downloads that day, Sensor Tower said, adding:

Sensor Tower also notes that during the week of September 21 to September 27, Muse ranked among the top 15 brands in U.S. ad impressions.
